existing_feature_gaps.brandability: No approved brandability transform or trademark/domain clearance; all three exploratory names have descriptive, prior-use, terminology, or semantic risks.
existing_feature_gaps.competition_gap: Marketplace result pages mix raw and ready-to-eat products, duplicates, and sponsored cards; no approved deduplicated brand-share or concentration transform exists.
existing_feature_gaps.demand: No reproducible U.S. sales, panel, conversion, or approved demand-proxy series; marketplace presence and mentions do not establish demand.
existing_feature_gaps.margin: Sensitivity scenarios are not quotes; landed cost lacks a supplier quote, freight quote, product-specific tariff ruling, customs overhead, fulfillment contract, and measured breakage.
existing_feature_gaps.regulatory_risk: General duties are identifiable, but exact formula, claims, facility status, FSVP importer, HTS classification, tariff stack, and APHIS treatment are unresolved.
existing_feature_gaps.repeat_purchase: No cohort, reorder, household panel, or measured consumption-cadence evidence exists.
existing_feature_gaps.search_velocity: No reproducible U.S. time series with provider version, date window, and request identity was captured.
existing_feature_gaps.shelf_stability: No finished, seasoned product shelf-life study or supplier specification tied to the proposed package was obtained.
existing_feature_gaps.shipping: Physical research supports fragility and low density, but commercial package dimensions, zone rates, damage tests, and breakage allowances are absent.
existing_feature_gaps.social_velocity: Observed recipes, videos, and anecdotes lack a reproducible U.S. time series and cannot be converted from mention counts into demand.
existing_feature_gaps.supplier_depth: Multiple suppliers claim capability, but no independent entity verification, quote, certificate, audit, COA, sample, or on-time performance evidence exists.
